source.title: Bitcoin's Short Squeeze Just Flipped The Market
source.description: Bitcoin short squeeze and spot ETF inflows with Backpack's Armani Ferrante on tokenized stocks and what holds the Bitcoin bid. Bitcoin rebounded above $80,000 after about $560 million in short liquidations, and Wednesday's spot Bitcoin ETFs flipped to a $74.6 million net inflow after three outflow days. I ask Armani Ferrante whether the squeeze is durable, what a $657 million day of tokenized US stock trading on Solana means for Backpack Securities, and how a Democratic Congress that wants a bigger SEC changes the path for on-chain equities and stock perps. We also cover Strategy's STRC prefer
